title: Ping Pong
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Childhood friends Makoto 'Smile' Tsukimoto, an impassive boy who plays table tennis 'to kill time', and Yutaka 'Peco' Hoshino, a brash player who loves to win, enter high school and are pushed by a coach who sees their potential. The road to the summer tournament runs through rival schools and a Chinese exchange student who nearly made the Olympic team.
life_message: Talent means little until a person finds a reason of their own to play, and friendship and rivalry can help them find it.
